components.name: I2C LCD 16x2
components.pins: SDA on A4, SCL on A5
components.notes: LiquidCrystal_I2C lcd(0x27, 16, 2); initialized with lcd.init(); lcd.backlight();

components.name: DHT11 Temperature & Humidity Sensor
components.notes: DHT dht(7, DHT11); dht.begin(); readTemperature() and readHumidity()

components.name: Room Light / Main LED
components.notes: Digital output driving room lighting / LED. Automatically turns ON when dark (LDR < 50) or via AI command.

components.name: LDR (Photoresistor)
components.notes: Read with analogRead(A0) to measure ambient light level (< 50 = dark, >= 70 = bright)

components.name: AC Status / Comfort LED
components.notes: Turns ON when AI recommends turning ON the AC (hot/humid conditions)

components.name: Buzzer
components.notes: Generates audio chimes and alerts. Supports tone(8, freq) and DC drive; noTone(8) to silence.
